name: macrogem-web-suite
description: Community plugins and themes for degoog search.
author: redue-wq

plugins.name: Deep AI Summary
plugins.description: AI summary panel with full-page fetching: the top results' pages are fetched server side and offered to the model as primary evidence, with per-page caps, timeouts and an optional external extractor. Forked from the official AI Summary plugin; also adds a custom panel title and max-sources setting.

plugins.name: Taxonomy Panel
plugins.description: When a search query matches a taxon in the Catalogue of Life (GBIF's primary taxonomy), shows a card above results with the full classification tree, IUCN status, occurrence stats and a range map.

engines.name: Marginalia
engines.description: Marginalia Search, the indie engine indexing the small, old and text-heavy web. Uses the official API; the shared "public" key rate-limits, get a personal key via contact@marginalia-search.com.

engines.name: GBIF
engines.description: Photos of life on Earth from the Global Biodiversity Information Facility: field observations, herbarium sheets, museum specimens and fossils, through the official GBIF API. No key needed.

themes.name: Bong
themes.description: Microslop implies the existence of Macrogem.
